name: selective_predicate_surgery_v3_catastrophic_harm_audit
research_question: Can the existing p1.9 concrete proposals recover positive mR once catastrophic native-relation damage is vetoed or cost-weighted?

stages.P0: learned proposal, oracle harm veto, oracle native-correct veto, positive-only proposal ceiling
stages.P1: existing G4 probabilities with analytic class-aware asymmetric cost (G5)
stages.P2: factorized rescue/harm logistic heads with class-aware asymmetric cost (G6)

select_and_calib: oracle harm veto capture >= 20 percent of full oracle gain
audit_gate.on_fail: kill compact-feature gate family; do not run G5/G6

select_and_calib: calib gain is greater than p1.9 G4
fit_promote_gate.on_fail: kill v3 fit line; do not load dev carrier
fit_promote_gate.on_pass: authorize one-shot dev evaluation with +4.4706 mR pp, delta_R >= -0.5 pp, edit rate <= 5 percent
